examples.arabic: بعد ساعات طويلة اصبح الطبق جاهزا والرائحة كانت شهية جدا
examples.english: After long hours, the dish was ready, and the smell was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da sa'at tawilah asbaha at-tabaq jahizan wa ar-ra'ihah kanat shahiyyah jiddan.

examples.arabic: بعد ساعات من النقاش توصلنا الى حل رائع وهو الذهاب الى حديقة المنزل
examples.english: After hours of discussion, we reached a wonderful solution: going to the home garden.
examples.transliteration: baʿda sāʿātin mina al-niqāshi tawwaṣalnā ilā ḥallin rāʾiʿin wa huwa al-dhahābu ilā ḥadīqat al-manzili.

examples.arabic: وبعد ساعات من العمل ظهر الطبق التقليدي بشكل شهي ونكهة رائعة
examples.english: After hours of work, the traditional dish appeared delicious with a wonderful flavor
examples.transliteration: Wa baʿda sāʿāt min al-ʿamal ẓahara aṭ-ṭabaqu at-taqlīdī bi-shaklin shahī wa nakhatin rā'iʿah

examples.arabic: قضينا ساعات معا نتعلم التقاليد القديمة مما قرب الاجيال
examples.english: We spent hours together learning the old traditions, which brought the generations closer
examples.transliteration: Qaḍaynā sāʿātīn maʿan nataʿallamu at-taqālīda al-qadīmah mimmā qarraba al-ajyāl

examples.arabic: قضيت ساعات قليلة في المطبخ اتبع وصفة معقدة قليلا
examples.english: I spent a few hours in the kitchen following a slightly complex recipe.
examples.transliteration: qadaytu sa'at qaleelah fi al-matbakhi attabi'u wasfah mu'aqqadah qaleelan
examples.storyTitle: Preparing a New Dish for the Family
